source: ICAO Doc 4444 (PANS-ATM) 4.5.7.5 and Annex 10 Vol II 5.2.1.7.3 - items the pilot must read back

must_read_back.desc: ATC route clearances (destination, SID/route, initial level)
Clearances to enter, land on, take off from, hold short of, cross, taxi or backtrack on any runway
Conditional clearances (the condition must be read back too)

always: End every read-back with your callsign.
